video.title: AsyncImage, SymbolRenderingMode & ContentTransition | Day 188
video.description:
Learn to explain how to show web images, colorful symbols and changing numbers in SwiftUI: AsyncImage, SymbolRenderingMode & ContentTransition, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
AsyncImage - A view that downloads an image from a web address and shows it.
SymbolRenderingMode - A setting that chooses how an SF Symbol uses color, such as multicolor or hierarchical.
ContentTransition - A setting that decides how the content of a view changes, such as rolling digits.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

Explain AsyncImage, SymbolRenderingMode & ContentTransition in SwiftUI by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
에이싱크이미지, 심볼렌더링모드, 콘텐츠트랜지션 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

AsyncImage - A view that downloads an image from a web address and shows it.
한국어: 에이싱크이미지: 웹 주소에서 이미지를 내려받아 보여 주는 뷰

SymbolRenderingMode - A setting that chooses how an SF Symbol uses color, such as multicolor or hierarchical.
한국어: 심볼렌더링모드: 멀티컬러나 계층형처럼 SF 심볼이 색을 쓰는 방식을 고르는 설정

ContentTransition - A setting that decides how the content of a view changes, such as rolling digits.
한국어: 콘텐츠트랜지션: 숫자가 굴러가듯 뷰의 내용이 바뀌는 방식을 정하는 설정

landscape.hook: Can you explain AsyncImage, SymbolRenderingMode and ContentTransition in English?

dialogue.title: A profile screen

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, my profile screen needs a picture from the internet.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use AsyncImage with a `url`. It downloads and shows the image for you.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What does AsyncImage show while it loads?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A placeholder. You can set your own view for that, and an error view too.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Nice. Now my heart icon is one flat color.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Set the SymbolRenderingMode. With `.multicolor`, the symbol uses its own colors.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What other SymbolRenderingMode values are there?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Monochrome, hierarchical and palette. Try each one.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Last, my like counter jumps from 2 to 3 with no animation.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Add a ContentTransition. With `.numericText()`, the digits roll to the new number.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Does a ContentTransition work on all views?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Mostly on text and symbols, and you need an animation to see it.

dialogue.code:
let url = URL(string: "https://a.com/p.png")
AsyncImage(url: url)
Image(systemName: "heart.fill")
    .symbolRenderingMode(.multicolor)
Text("3").contentTransition(.numericText())
